description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ziggs''' hurls a charge to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds and granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area. ''Satchel Charge'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. If recast while in flight, the charge will explode immediately upon landing.
description.text: Active: Ziggs hurls a charge to the target location, remaining there for 4 seconds and granting sight of the area. Satchel Charge can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. If recast while in flight, the charge will explode immediately upon landing.

description2.raw: '''Recast:''' '''Ziggs''' detonates the charge, causing it to explode to deal magic damage to nearby enemies and [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knock them back]] over 0.5 seconds up to 500 units away from the center of the explosion, though not through terrain. If this hits '''Ziggs''', he will [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] up to 825 units away from the center.
description2.text: Recast: Ziggs detonates the charge, causing it to explode to deal magic damage to nearby enemies and knock them back over 0.5 seconds up to 500 units away from the center of the explosion, though not through terrain. If this hits Ziggs, he will dash up to 825 units away from the center.

description3.raw: [[File:Satchel Charge Turret Explosion Indicator.png|20xpx|link=|An icon representing ]] '''Turret Explosion:''' The explosion also [[File:Successfully enhanced damage magic icon.png|20px|link=Damage#Successful_ability_casts]] [[File:Death from Below.png|20px|link=Kill#Execute|An icon representing the keyword Execute]] [[:Kill#Execute|executes]] enemy [[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turrets]] within that are below a '''maximum''' health threshold.
description3.text: Turret Explosion: The explosion also executes enemy turrets within that are below a maximum health threshold.

description4.raw: '''''Ziggs''' will not [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] from the explosion if he is [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Immobilizing|An icon representing the keyword Immobilize]] [[:Crowd_control#Immobilizing|immobilized]] or [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounded]]. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''
description4.text: Ziggs will not dash from the explosion if he is immobilized or grounded. He can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

leveling2.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 (+ 50% AP)

leveling3.raw:
'''Demolition Threshold:'''
25 / 27.5 / 30 / 32.5 / 35% of turret's '''maximum''' health
leveling3.text: Demolition Threshold:25 / 27.5 / 30 / 32.5 / 35% of turret's maximum health

notes.raw: *The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. **Detonating the ability manually does not. * Deals [[File:Mega Inferno Bomb.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Area damage]] [[:Damage|area damage]] to non-turrets and [[File:Fear Beyond Death 2.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Raw damage]] [[:Damage|raw damage]] to turrets. * ''Satchel Charge's'' distance increases with proximity to the charge, resulting in being knocked straight up when aligned directly on top of it. * '''Ziggs''' will not ''dash'' from ''Satchel Charge's'' detonation while [[File:Teleport.png|20xpx|border|link=Teleport|An icon representing Teleport]] [[Teleport|Teleporting]] but he will while [[File:Recall.png|20xpx|border|link=Recall|An icon representing Recall]] [[Recall|Recalling]].
notes.text:
The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
*Detonating the ability manually does not.
Deals area damage to non-turrets and raw damage to turrets.
Satchel Charge's distance increases with proximity to the charge, resulting in being knocked straight up when aligned directly on top of it.
Ziggs will not dash from Satchel Charge's detonation while Teleporting but he will while Recalling.
